QuestInfo.name: Moonbeam's Paw Stamp
QuestInfo.0: You need paw stamps from the town foxes to be acknowledged as a fox. Go to Moonbeam to take the fifth test.
QuestInfo.1: Moonbeam says the tests are up to each fox. She wants to just give you hers, but if Silver found out he'd be pretty mad. You wonder if this is okay...but you decide it won't matter since you're not a real fox anyway.
QuestInfo.2: Thanks to Moonbeam and her free paw stamp, you're all done proving your foxhood.

0.0: Whoa, you got four paw stamps already? Maybe you're not so helpless after all. Here, I can just give you mine. Oh, the whole test thing isn't required or anything. It's my paw stamp, so I can do whatever I want! Where do you want it? Here? Or there?

yes.0: Wait, I think Grandpa's looking this way. He keeps treating me like a kit, even though I passed my own test! Anyway it's up to me, but I know that he'll nag on me if he found out. So gimme a second.

no.0: No? Why not? It's up to each fox to decide what their stamp is worth. I got my paw stamp from Mrs. #p3002008# after babysitting her kids for, like, an hour.

yes.0: Here it is. Now you have five paw stamps. Go to Grandpa, and remember, this is a secret between you and me! \r\n                                                                 #fUI/DialogImage.img/quest/0
